reports.title: Delek Logistics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

lines: •Raising full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to $530 million – $560 million, driven by strong year-to-date operational performance and including $15 million of contribution from 2026 organic growth projects
“With the confidence in the business, we are increasing our 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance of $520 to $560 million to $530 to $560 million.

In the 2026 guidance we have recognized approximately $15 million of growth related to growth capital spend within the year with an additional $60 million in EBITDA growth expected in 2027 related to this capital spend.
